summary: The Mission Bay Branch Library, a San Francisco Public Library branch at 960 4th St, on the ground floor of a multi-use building, that opened on July 8, 2006 (SFPL); the Assessor roll lists a 2005 year built.

milestones.text: DBI issues permit 200407088299 (filed July 8, 2004) for an interior improvement of shell space "to create branch library" at 201 Berry St, estimated cost $1,500,000; DBI's record lists its status as expired (status date 2011-11-02), with no completion date

Opened: San Francisco Public Library's Mission Bay Library history page states the branch opened its doors on this date; the library's Facts & Figures sheet gives the Grand Opening as July 8, 2006 and names the library architect as Santos Prescott and Associates, the building architect as Hardison Komatsu Ivelich and Tucker, the developer as Mercy Housing California and the general contractor as Cahill Contractors

DBI records the new-construction permit 200208093627 ("erect 7 story 140 dwelling units, office, library, retail & parking" at 201 Berry St; filed 2002-08-09, issued 2003-07-29) as completed. This is the permit's completed date for the whole building, not the library's opening

open_questions: Pier & Point's own field photos are shown on this record. Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm on 2026-09-27; fuller details shown in this record's map notes (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no costs or facts.

Phil'z Coffee at 201 Berry St: DataSF Registered Business Locations gives a registration start of 2007-04-01, which is not an opening date, and no source found dates the opening; the tenant's own locations page (philzcoffee.com/locations) lists the Berry St store as of 2026-09-29.

The Assessor parcel this record is joined to (8708110) is listed at 201 Berry St, with a 2005 year built, while the library is at 960 4th St. DBI's permits filed under 960 4th St show only house-number and street-space permits, but permits under the parcel's address 201 Berry St (block 8708, lot 006 when filed, before the lots were renumbered) cover the library: 200208093627 (new construction of a 7-story building with 140 dwelling units, office, library, retail and parking; completed 2007-03-08) and 200407088299 (interior improvement of shell space \"to create branch library\", issued 2005-04-19, status expired with no completion date). The permits' completion dates are for the building or are absent, and the library's own stated opening (July 8, 2006) falls between them; the date shown as the opening is the library's.
